rules: Preserve user work; never delete/overwrite without an explicit approved operation.
Engineering changes are branch-first and reversible; create/verify rollback before deployment.
Never claim success without evidence from a test, API response, broker reconciliation, file hash, or equivalent.
Use deterministic code for scheduling/filtering/state transitions; use LLMs for judgement/synthesis/generation.
Write durable state/handoffs; do not rely on chat history as the only state.
On human-only blocker: record exact blocker, attempted work, evidence, and smallest required human action.
